title: 1887 Winchester Restoration and Conservation; Anvil 049
description:
Deep dive into recovery of an 1887 that really, really needed/deserved it. BLACK powder only, please
Remember, we are showing you what we do, not how to do it. If you do not possess the necessary skills to perform work at this level, do not attempt to replicate what you see here. If you're going to be dumb, you have to be TOUGH.   Support us on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/anvil.
